description: Irrigated agriculture in the Murray-Darling Basin: an economic survey of irrigators, 2012-13 to 2014-15 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences. Irrigated agriculture in the Murray-Darling Basin: an economic survey of irrigators 2012-13 to 2014-15 presents key farm performance measures for irrigated horticulture, dairy, cotton and rice farms in the Basin, including data on water trading and use of irrigation technologies and with an emphasis on results from 2012-13 to 2014-15. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences. Its tags are AGRICULTURE, Farming, Murray-Darling Basin, farm, farm performance. It offers 3 resource(s) in pdf, word, xml. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
